## Summary

Describe the structural intelligence changed and its public attribution basis.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Every new format includes a representative text sample that I am authorized to publish.
- [ ] I removed live credentials, cookies, session tokens, wallet secrets, and direct victim identifiers.
- [ ] I kept the original filename, field order, spelling, separators, and useful malware markers.
- [ ] I did not include malware binaries, archives, browser databases, or bulk account data.
- [ ] New known-family claims include an external reference; provisional labels are neutral and do not claim attribution.
- [ ] I ran `python tools/catalog.py validate` and the standard-library test suite.
- [ ] I reviewed generated YARA as experimental exported-log-text classification only.
